Mechanisms of Diabetogenic Action of Statins
Liu Shuyuan，Su Yixin ( Department of Pharmacy，Ordos Central Hospital，Inner Mongolia Ordos 017000，China)ABSTRACT Objective: To alarm the effect of statins on blood glucose，and provide evidence for the rational use of statins in clinics． Methods: The recent articles on the effects and potential mechanisms of diabetogenic action of statins were reviewed and summarized． Results and Conclusion: Stains，especially lipophilic stains，could increase blood glucose via multiple pathways to induce diabetes． The potential mechanisms included inhibiting L-type calcium channel，increasing the uptake of plasma-derived LDL-C，inhibiting synthesis of ATP and Coenzyme Q10，inhibiting the expression of glucose transporter 4 and inducing β-cell inflammation，oxidation and apoptosis． Blood glucose should be monitored and adjusted timely when statins are used in clinics．他汀类调脂药通过抑制 3-羟基-3-甲基-戊二酰辅酶 A还原酶 ( 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl coenzyme A，HMG-CoA)
